headline: Oman Stock Market Drops Amid Regional Uncertainty and Shipping Disruptions
summary: The Muscat Stock Exchange MSX 30 index declined 3.89% to 7,379.41 points amid geopolitical uncertainties and maritime shipping disruptions.
why: Regional geopolitical tensions and trade route disruptions directly weigh on equity valuations and trading volumes in Middle Eastern bourses.

impacts.name: Stock Market
impacts.why: Broader security uncertainties prompt risk-off sentiment among local institutional and retail investors.

why_moved: Escalating geopolitical concerns involving maritime disruptions and regional security pressures triggered broad equity sell-offs in Oman.
